scripts.build:ext: bun build vscode-ext/src/extension.ts --target node --format cjs --external vscode --outfile vscode-ext/dist/extension.js
scripts.demo:reset: git fetch -q origin && git checkout origin/main -- demo/sample && (git diff --cached --quiet -- demo/sample || git commit -qm 'demo: reset sample' --no-verify -- demo/sample) && echo 'demo/sample is back to the GitHub version'
